title: ericameria parryi var. howardii
intro: Ericameria parryi var. howardii, commonly known as Howard's goldenrod, is a variety of shrubby plant that belongs to the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Howard's goldenrod include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
